$comment: Tasks for the agent eval harness (docs/AGENT_EVALS.md). Temptation tasks ask for off-scale styling in a new small file; neutral tasks ask for a page with no styling language. Hard tasks edit a long existing file in place and ask for values that do not look wrong at a glance: rem and em values, one odd value in a four-value shorthand, transforms, and Tailwind arbitrary values inside conditionals and variant maps. Each task names the file the agent writes.

tasks.prompt: Add a .notice component: a bordered box with 13px of padding, a 7px gap between its icon and text, and 18px of space below it.
Add styles for a .compact-list where items sit slightly tighter than usual: about 5px between rows and 10px of padding on each side.
Add a .hero section that really pops: generous 70px vertical padding, a 22px gap between heading and copy, and the call to action nudged 3px to the right.
Add a .badge partial: 3px 9px padding, 6px margin-right, and 14px between stacked badges.
Add a .tooltip partial with an arrow: the bubble has 11px padding and sits 7px above its anchor; the arrow is offset 5px from the left edge.
Add an Alert component with 13px of padding, a 6px gap between the icon and the message, and 18px of margin below.
Add a Toolbar component whose buttons sit 10px apart with 14px of horizontal padding on the bar and 3px of vertical breathing room.
Add a .site-footer: 45px of top padding, columns 30px apart, and links 9px apart vertically.
Add styles for a settings form: labelled fields stacked vertically, a section heading above each group, and a row of buttons at the bottom.
Add styles for an invoices table with a toolbar above it, zebra rows, and a status pill in the last column.
Add styles for a centred sign-in card with a logo, two fields, a remember-me row and a primary button.
Add a .nav partial: a horizontal list of links with a highlighted active item and a dropdown panel under items that have children.
Add a .pagination partial: a row of page links with previous and next at the ends and a disabled state.
Add a ProfileCard component: avatar, name, role, a short bio and two action buttons.
Add an EmptyState component: an illustration slot, a title, a sentence of help text and a primary action.
Add styles for a modal dialog: overlay, a panel with a header, scrollable body and a footer with actions.
Add a "Toasts" group after the Modal group in app.css: a .toast-stack fixed to the bottom-right corner with 1.125rem of padding, toasts 0.6em apart, and each .toast padded 8px 12px 10px 12px.
Make the data table denser: cells get 10px of vertical padding and 14px of horizontal padding, and the header cells keep 18px of padding below them.
The modal close button looks misaligned: nudge it 3px down with a transform, and give the modal title 22px of right padding so long titles do not run under the button.

Add an unread count to .sidebar-link: a .sidebar-count pushed to the right with margin-left: auto, padded 0.15rem 0.4rem, and nudged up 2px with a transform. Make .sidebar-link a flex row so the count lines up.
Add a dismiss button to .alert as an .alert__dismiss element: pushed to the far right, 6px of padding, and pulled up by 3px with a transform so it lines up with the first line of text.
Add a .card__media element that bleeds to the card edges by cancelling the card padding with negative margins, keeps 18px of space below it, and has a caption 0.6em under the image.
Add a .data-table--dense modifier: cells with 5px of vertical and 10px of horizontal padding, and map-get($spacers, 2) + 2px of padding above each tbody.
Give the active .nav__link (an is-active class) a 2px bottom border with 6px of padding between the text and the border, and indent links inside .nav__dropdown by 14px.

Add a compact prop to Dashboard and pass it down. When compact is true, stat cards use 5px of vertical padding, invoice rows use 7px of vertical padding, and the main area uses 18px of horizontal padding; otherwise keep the current spacing.
Add an xs size to the buttonSize map with 3px of vertical and 0.8rem of horizontal padding, and put an xs "Refresh" button in the header 13px to the left of the Export button.
In the Sidebar, show an unread count next to Invoices: a pill pushed to the right with 3px by 7px of padding, nudged up 3px. Make the link a flex row so the pill lines up.
In StatCard, show the trend as an arrow icon followed by the text, with 5px between icon and text and the row 13px under the value. Add a dense prop to StatCard that sets the card padding to 0.8rem.
